entries.claim: This setting’s RG115a supplies the complete Father-directed Per Dominum ending w030–w050 and Amen w051, excluding the proper body. The literal rubric list is unaccented. The matching common words on p.123 and terminal on p.226 control selected stress; p.226 also distinguishes the Amen response period. These controls do not establish response actors, singing or the distribution of conclusions in grouped orations.
